journal_lines: §oAir thin enough to notice by the second pass up the slope. Noticed it. Kept climbing.
§aGoat on a ridge with no clear way down. Found a way down. §lGoat§a did not.
Chased something sure-footed up loose scree. Matched it step for step. The chase ended at the top.
§aHigh prey runs hard. The altitude costs both of you equally — except the wolf trained for it.
Tracked smell upslope through three switchbacks before the wind shifted. Adjusted. Caught up.
§aThe mountain makes everything harder. §lMountain quarry§a makes the carry worthwhile.
§oCold above the treeline, rock warm where the sun had been on it all morning. Good hunting ground.
§aCame down with a full bag and the summit behind. Both earned.
